notes.title: New patch: Stability & bug fixing
notes.content:
Hi players,

A new [b]patch[/b] for [i]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/i] is now available for download, which includes bug fixing and additional improvements.

Here’s the [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*]General stability improvements
[*]Framerate capped at 120 fps
[*]Crash fix leaving Gallery[/list]

Thank you for your patience and your feedback!

HOOK Team

notes.title: Vote the EDENGATE’s soundtrack in the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Hi Player,

During the [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b], you can nominate [i]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/i] for the Steam Awards category “[b]Best Soundtrack[/b]”.

The OST of the game was composed by the talented Laryssa Okada, whom we can never thank enough for her lovely work!

[previewyoutube=6-jBPt8ylxI;full][/previewyoutube]

You can listen to the playlist [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=OLAK5uy_nGjCuYRT3CTZuHeC3nzhynR1ZjkFwAcqk ]here[/url].

Thank you

- HOOK Team
